result.topic_en: Scattered calculations for the case p=4, apparently on representing a quartic expression via products of linear factors (a form like (γ…+e…+fxyz)^2 − 4ed(…)(…)), coefficient expansions of a squared polynomial, bilinear forms under linear substitution, and a count of constants (p+1)p/2 − 3(p−1) leading to (p−2)(p−3)/2.

methods.what: Representation of a form F as a square minus 4ed times a product (discriminant-type expression) built from products of linear factors
methods.quote: $\Big(\gamma\big((x+\alpha_1 y)^2(x+\alpha_2 y)+\cdots\big) + e\big((x+\alpha_1 y)^2(x+\alpha_3 y)+\cdots\big) + f\,xyz\Big)^2 - 4ed\big((x+\alpha_1 y)(x+\alpha_2 y)+\cdots\big)\big((x+\alpha_2 y)(x+\alpha_3 y)+\cdots\big) = F.$

methods.what: Coefficient expansion of the square of a monic polynomial
Symmetric bilinear form arising from product of two linear forms
